# semgrep 1.180.0 pins the opentelemetry 1.37.0 / 0.58b0 family. opentelemetry-api
# <= 1.45.0 has unbounded tracestate parsing (GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h, Dependabot alert 38,
# fixed in 1.45.1). semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps, so these overrides lift the
# whole family together (api/sdk/exporter at 1.45.x pull the matching 0.66b instrumentation
# packages). Drop this file once semgrep's own pins allow opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading

# semgrep (1.180.0 through 1.184.0, the latest) pins mcp==1.29.0. mcp < 1.30.0 has three
# advisories (GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23, GHSA-5h93-6whr-6q8j, GHSA-rwrf-2pqf-9j8j; Dependabot
# alerts 41-43 and 45-47). semgrep only imports mcp for its `semgrep mcp` server command,
# which CI never runs, so lifting it is safe. Drop this line once semgrep's pin allows >= 1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
